upcoming.title: Treasury auction: 5-year note
upcoming.explainer: The US Treasury sells new government debt at auction. Strong demand tends to pull yields down; weak demand can push yields up, which often weighs on Nasdaq stocks.

rates.explainer: Treasury yields are the interest rate the US government pays to borrow. The 2-year follows what traders expect the Fed to do with rates; the 10-year reflects longer-run growth and inflation. Rising yields usually weigh on Nasdaq stocks, because the future profits that tech prices depend on are worth less today when safe bonds pay more. Falling yields usually help.

draft.headline: NQ futures firm before the open; durable goods numbers not yet known
draft.summary: Nasdaq 100 futures are up +0.58% before the open. The VIX fear gauge is lower and the 10-year yield is flat. This morning's durable goods figures are not known yet, so a key data read is still missing.
draft.what_it_means: Two reports were due this morning. ADP's weekly private hiring estimate showed 17K, versus 18K the week before. There was no forecast, so it cannot be called a surprise. It was little changed. Durable goods orders track big-ticket items like machines and planes. They were due at 08:30, with forecasts of 2.0% and 0.6% for the core measure. The actual numbers are not known yet. Headlines say the Fed is expected to hold rates this week, with talk of possible future hikes.
draft.market_reaction: Nasdaq 100 futures are up +0.58% and S&P 500 futures are up +0.40%. The VIX fear gauge fell -3.59%. In the window after the ADP report, NQ gained +0.17%. After 08:30 it slipped -0.08%. Without the durable goods numbers, the cause of that small dip is unclear. Oil eased -0.73% to $101.02. The dollar rose +0.21%, and gold barely moved at -0.02%.
draft.rates_read: The 2-year yield tracks Fed expectations. It is up +1.5bp to 4.726%. The 10-year is unchanged today at 4.986% but down -12.9bp over the past week. Falling longer-term yields help tech stocks because future profits are worth more today. Both yields edged up after 08:30, by +1.0bp for the 2-year and +1.3bp for the 10-year. That is a small move, but worth watching.

draft.learn: Treasury auction: the government borrows by selling bonds to investors. If demand is weak, buyers ask for higher yields. That can push rates up and weigh on Nasdaq stocks. Strong demand tends to calm yields. Today's 5-year note sale is $70 billion.
